notes.title: Radio
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34947671/492a76c9ea2f94695eea35bd2dbf464ed993e229.jpg[/img]


Living in the 1970s must've been an experience in itself. All the world around us was changing. 
So many reforms and change
- Social
- Technological
- Economical
- Borders just to name a few.

Radio was a big part of everyone's life in the 1970s.
They had hand radios, radios in their bicycles, cars everywhere. I had to put a radio system in the game so here it is.



During the 1970s music was huge, bigger than television if I may say so. The top genre were Jazz, Smooth Jazz, Jazz Fusion, Jazz Blues, Disco, Funk. 

During this time two new genres were rising : Rock and Hip-Hop(in the USA).

The radio plays 2 stations and 1 station needs to be unlocked in game. 
Stations :

- Jezzy Station tuned at 93.5 (Jazz and Blues)

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34947671/bdebb932537ebc9c19f270f1c1b7a97c14ddbb5a.png[/img]

- Disco 99 Station tuned at 99 (Disco and Funk)

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34947671/2ad9c525a59b0944301eaea9754924004cc95880.png[/img]


- Rolla 104 Station tuned at 104 (Rock and Roll)

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34947671/8966708e73217d719b83c20748135fda2aada1b0.png[/img]


I wish to put in some voice acting but they are pretty expensive, so right now its just music tracks.

notes.title: Wilkommen to Times-Ville
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34947671/928fdf7bbfd034b9f0bc22735a47514026e0f226.jpg[/img]
[h1]


I'm happy to welcome all you new citizens of Times-Ville. [/h1]

[b]What is Times Ville ?[/b]
Times-Ville is a small European town somewhere in the Mid-West of Europe during the 70s just after the wars ended. It has a population of 25,000 people.

[b]What is Rick Rack ?[/b]
Rick Rack is a design pattern generally a flat piece of [b]BRAID[/b]ed trim, shaped like a zigzag. It is used as a decorative element in clothes, curtains.

[b]Why is BRAID in Bold ?[/b]
The game uses a mechanic which was used in the game Braid. Time Rewinding.
The game is inspired from the movie Donnie Darko. The game's story has something related to that movie.

[b]Why is the Game's name Rick Rack ?[/b]
The game's name is Rick Rack because the player will be bouncing around literally and metaphorically by making life decisions for few of the citizens of Time-Ville.


[b]Decisions, Choices, Story ? The Premise [/b]
The town of Times-Ville has met with an incident which somehow broke the fabric of time and sent the town and its citizens in a loop. The loop will stay until the event is avoided or it will create an Alternative Universe.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34947671/6991a139b1b41cb70d1ee46736ec7cb0292bdb8c.jpg[/img]

[b]How to end the Loop ?[/b]
The time loop and the citizens are somehow interlinked. Few of the citizens 15 to be exact had taken some crucial decisions few days before the event and the options they had chosen are linked to the event.
Their actions can either STOP the incident or LET it happen.

The player will be in control of these 15 people and will be driving around town, living their day-to-day lives and making choices trying to take the time loop towards the corrective path to merge the Alternate timeline with the Main timeline.

That just about sums up the introduction to the game and the FAQs.
Welcome to Times-Ville. Welcome to Rick Rack.

[b]See you in the game.[/b]
